thread:
Maria: kicking off canary for model v6 today. plan: EU first, then NA. traffic slices 0% -> 3% -> 15% over ~6h windows. tagging feature flag: feature_flag.model_v6_canary. can someone confirm guardrails and oncall visibility?

Kevin: noted. can you paste the exact toggle key & rollout command? I'll patch infra policy.

Maria: flag key above. rollout command (for the feature service):
```
POST /flags/feature_flag.model_v6_canary/rollout
{ "scope": ["region:eu-west-1"], "steps": [ {"pct":3, "duration_mins":180}, {"pct":15, "duration_mins":360} ], "metadata": {"initiator":"maria", "change_reason":"v6 perf ramp"} }
```

Sara: ops checklist:
- add canary metrics dashboard (p95 latency, error-rate, rejection-rate, nv-calls)
- set alert: error_rate > 0.8% sustained 5m OR p95 increase > +25%
- oncall paging policy: page after alert AND if model fallback rate > 2%
I'll post dashboard link in a min.

DeployBot: Deploy pipeline started for model-v6-serving-group-3. build: sha@c5a1f2. ETA warmup: ~12m.

OncallBot: @oncall roster (eu) notified: @Tim. Slack page channel: #eng-oncall. Pager duty routing set to primary->secondary.

Tim: I saw the ping. I'll be watching the dashboards. what is rollback threshold? do we want automatic rollback?

Maria: prefer manual rollback but auto-guard to disable canary if key signal hits hard. thresholds:
- errors > 1.5% for 3m -> disable flag automatically
- p95 > 1.2s AND +40% vs baseline for 3m -> notify and wait 5m before auto-disable
- unexpected tokenization regressions -> immediate stop (we'll need eval alerts)

Kevin: I'll add a small orchestrator job to monitor metrics and flip the flag when the above hits. will emit reason tags for audit.

DevEx: quick note: dev console needs the rollout UI visible for product folks. I added a read-only view under "Canaries > model_v6". linking to the docs: https://internal.redwood/devex/canaries

Alice: one more ask: for NA ramp, do we mirror EU timings or shorter? NA load is heavier, maybe 2-step 0->5->25. also ensure KV-cache warmup pre-seed in NA.

Maria: good call. let's do EU 3%->15% (6h) then NA 5%->25% (4h). pre-seed cache in NA before traffic shift. I'll update rollout payload.

Sara: dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/model-v6-canary (panels: p95, errors, fallback-rate, mem/gpu-util). added alert rules and annotated them in the dashboard.

Tim: acknowledged. I'll be available for the EU window 1400-2100 UTC. pager escalation set. if anything spikes, I'll flip the flag and post reason.

Maria: thanks. final checklist before start:
- [x] flag key & rollout payload ready
- [x] dashboards & alerts configured
- [x] oncall is watching
- [x] deploy pipeline started
- [x] devex UI linked for PMs
- [ ] QA smoke on v6 responses (Sara/QA)

Sara: QA will run smoke in 20m and post sample diffs. I'll annotate any semantic regressions separately.

Kevin: orchestration job added and tested in staging. it will only run in prod after a manual trigger by @maria.

Maria: ok starting canary in 30m unless QA flags anything. will post start + rollout id. thx everyone :party_parrot:

DeployBot: Canary started. rollout_id: r-2076543210-01. scope: eu-west-1. initial pct: 3%.

Alice: copying the rollout id to release notes. good luck!

Sara: QA smoke passed. samples look reasonable; no obvious regressions on tokenization.

Tim: monitoring. no alert yet. p95 looks stable at baseline +5%.

Maria: posting periodic updates: 30m: stable. 3h: moving to 15% per plan. will switch region after warmup.

Kevin: added audit log entry for rollout_id r-2076543210-01 and orchestration actions.

OncallBot: annotation added to #incidents: "model-v6 canary r-2076543210-01 started by Maria"

Maria: moving NA staging pre-seed now. will update when NA rollout kicks off.

End of thread.
